purpose: Comparator records for NYSC COURSE-028 Lapiderist (Gem Cutting). The governed catalogue publishes no module headings for this course, so the records are shown without a competency matrix. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality or labour demand.
status_note: No record has been human-verified yet. Every record must be checked against its official source by a researcher before publication.

country_group_gaps.developing_emerging: No developing/emerging-economy gem-cutting curriculum was verified on 2026-10-18: TESDA's training-regulations listing shows only Jewelry Making qualifications (titles only; not inspected), and web searches of India's NQR returned only Stone Preparation Artisan and Jeweller qualification files (search results only; not inspected).
country_group_gaps.developed: No developed-economy gem-cutting qualification was verified on 2026-10-18: Australia's Opal Cutting and Polishing qualifications are superseded or deleted, and current training.gov.au results are jewellery-handling units only.

records.institution: Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission / National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority

modules.title_verbatim: Facet and polish preformed rough gemstones
Facet and polish gemstones using traditional machines
Carry out cabochoning and polishing of phenomenal, highly included or highly fractured gemstones
Perform drilling, engraving & carving of gemstones
Maintain and Repair lapidary Machines, tools and equipment
Practice workplace communication and interpersonal relations
Practice occupational health and safety procedures in a workplace

source.publication_or_revision: First Revision May 2022 (endorsed 30.05.2022); next revision May 2025

verification.method: Unit titles, codes and NVQ packaging read from the List of Competency Units (PDF page 8); endorsement from the detail page (PDF page 87); all matched against the pdf.js text layer.

notes: A national occupational standard, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.
Stores the 17 competency units only; curriculum modules and hours are not stored and no overall course duration is stated.
The title matches the NYSC course (published as 'Lapiderist (Gem Cutting)').
The NVQ Level 4 packaging passage writes unit 11 as 'U011'; it is stored as published.
The stated date of review (30.05.2025) has passed and the NVQ portal serves no later revision (2026-10-18).
scope_verbatim: National Certificate at NVQ Level 4 in the occupation of Lapidarist will be awarded to those who are competent in units U01+ U02+ U03+ U04+ U05+ U06+ U07+ U08+ U09+ U10+ U011+ U12+ U13 + BU01 + BU02 + BU03 + BU04 – D26S001Q5L4
